Metadata.Title: POLISH BRO'S MGS SERIES 6
Metadata.Description: greetings everyone, Polish bro here.Deep inside New York City, Hollow Circle has operated for years through bribery, blackmail, and contract killings. ICA intercepted intel confirming that the organization’s leaders are meeting tonight to secure their remaining assets before disappearing underground.Agent 47 has been deployed to infiltrate the meeting and eliminate every senior member before they escape the city. Once the leadership is gone, the entire network will collapse.happy hunting.Creator - Polishbro456
